subject: executor: clear probe state after probe is done (#56274)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for HashJoinV2 probe lifecycle changes in `pkg/executor/join/{base_join_probe.go,outer_join_probe.go,hash_join_v2.go}`. Change adds `ProbeV2.ClearProbeState()` and invokes it when join workers finish (and again during `Close`) to drop per-probe cached row info / iterators; also fixes `rowIndexInfos` population for other-condition joins to append only `cachedBuildRows[0:nextCachedBuildRowIndex]` instead of the whole fixed-size buffer. Checked for correctness/SQL semantics and concurrency: `ClearProbeState` is only reached after worker completion in `waitJoinWorkersAndCloseResultChan`, and in `Close` it is executed after `channel.Clear(e.joinResultCh)` has blocked until the result channel is closed (i.e., after worker shutdown), avoiding concurrent mutation of probe state. No remaining plausible Blocker/High issues found in executor behavior.
